content.user_title: Build an ISO 13485 Quality Management System
content.value_statement: Medical device teams need structured quality processes that align with ISO 13485. This skill provides practical guidance for QMS design, audits, CAPA, and reviews.
actual_capabilities: Structures ISO 13485 gap analyses and implementation roadmaps.
Outlines document control workflows for approval, distribution, revision, retention, and disposal.
Plans management reviews using required inputs, decisions, actions, and effectiveness follow-up.
Designs risk-based internal audit programs and audit follow-up activities.
Connects design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, supplier quality, and QMS monitoring.
Defines quality indicators for complaints, audits, CAPA, training, and process performance.
limitations: It provides guidance and draft structures, not legal advice or certification approval.
Users must verify current standards, regulations, and jurisdiction-specific requirements.
Referenced scripts, templates, and supporting documents may not be available in the installed skill.
Outputs require review against the organization, device class, products, and established procedures.

use_cases.title: Plan a QMS implementation
use_cases.description: Create a prioritized ISO 13485 gap assessment and implementation roadmap for a growing medical device organization.

use_cases.title: Prepare an internal audit
use_cases.description: Develop a risk-based audit scope, criteria, schedule, interview plan, and follow-up process.

use_cases.title: Organize management review
use_cases.description: Compile QMS performance inputs, decisions, assigned actions, and effectiveness checks for leadership review.

prompt_templates.title: Create a QMS checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a beginner-friendly ISO 13485 QMS checklist for [organization type]. Cover documents, responsibilities, training, audits, CAPA, and management review.

prompt_templates.title: Assess document control
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this document control process: [process summary]. Identify gaps in approval, access, revision, retention, external documents, and obsolete document handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improving an existing document control process

prompt_templates.title: Design an audit program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a risk-based internal audit program for [QMS scope]. Include priorities, frequency, auditor competence, evidence, reporting, CAPA, and effectiveness verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning the annual internal audit cycle

prompt_templates.title: Develop an integrated improvement plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these QMS metrics and findings: [data]. Propose priorities integrating ISO 13485, ISO 14971, supplier controls, CAPA, and management review.

output_examples.input: Create a document control assessment for a small device manufacturer.
output: Priority gap: approval roles are not defined for controlled procedures.
Required action: establish document owners, reviewers, approvers, and release authority.
Evidence: approved templates, revision history, distribution records, and obsolete document controls.
Effectiveness check: sample released documents after implementation and verify authorized access.

output_examples.input: Prepare a quarterly management review agenda.
output: Review audit results, complaints, process performance, product conformity, CAPA status, and QMS changes.
Record decisions, resources, owners, due dates, and expected outcomes.
Confirm previous actions and evaluate their effectiveness.

output_examples.input: Outline an annual internal audit program.
output_examples.output: The program prioritizes high-risk and underperforming processes, defines scope and criteria, assigns competent independent auditors, and tracks corrections through effectiveness verification.

best_practices: Provide the organization scope, device types, markets, current procedures, and known quality issues.
Request traceable outputs that identify applicable clauses, evidence, owners, due dates, and effectiveness checks.
Review every draft with qualified quality, regulatory, process, and product stakeholders before controlled release.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated content as certification, legal advice, or regulatory approval.
Do not create generic procedures without matching actual responsibilities, systems, records, and product risks.
Do not close audit findings or CAPAs without objective evidence and effectiveness verification.

faq.question: Does this skill certify an ISO 13485 QMS?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and documentation, but an accredited certification body performs certification audits.

faq.question: Can it create controlled QMS documents?
faq.answer: It can draft structures and content. Your authorized document control process must review, approve, release, and maintain them.

faq.question: Does it cover internal audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure risk-based schedules, scopes, criteria, evidence plans, findings, CAPA follow-up, and effectiveness checks.

faq.question: Can it support management review?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize required inputs, decisions, action owners, resources, due dates, and follow-up evidence.

faq.question: Does it replace a qualified quality professional?
faq.answer: No. Qualified personnel must evaluate applicability, approve decisions, and verify compliance within the actual organization.

faq.question: Which regulations does it address?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 13485 and references ISO 14971, European MDR, and FDA quality system requirements. Users must verify current rules.
